archive.indexing: Still reading your recent mail — more results will appear.
archive.offline: ohmail Cloud can't be reached — showing the mail on this computer.
archive.unanswered: Your server did not answer — showing the recent mail this device holds.
archive.noRecipients: your whole mailbox cannot be searched by recipient yet
archive.noRecipientsWhy: This list is the recent mail sent to this address. Older mail sent to it cannot be listed yet.
archive.bySenderWhy: Your whole mailbox is searched by sender only, so this number counts the mail this address sent. Older mail sent to it is not counted yet.
archive.importing: The rest of your mail has not synced yet.

archive.wholeBySender: {count, plural, one {1 in your whole mailbox (by sender)} other {# in your whole mailbox (by sender)}}
archive.wholeBySenderAtLeast: {count, plural, other {at least # in your whole mailbox (by sender)}}
archive.synced: {count, plural, one {1 in the mail synced so far} other {# in the mail synced so far}}
archive.syncedAtLeast: {count, plural, other {at least # in the mail synced so far}}
archive.syncedBySender: {count, plural, one {1 in the mail synced so far (by sender)} other {# in the mail synced so far (by sender)}}
archive.syncedBySenderAtLeast: {count, plural, other {at least # in the mail synced so far (by sender)}}
